title.narrative: Institutional Development of Provedor de Direitos Humanos e da Justica

description.narrative: The objective of the Grant is to assist the Recipient in the creation and the institutional development of the Provedor de Direitos Humanos e Justica (the Ombudsman's Office) with regards (only) to its anti-corruption and rule-of-law mandate. Part A: Creation and institutional development of the Provedor de Direitos Humanos e Justica Provision of technical assistance, training, workshops, study tours, and equipment for: (i) the development of a medium term strategic plan; the preparation and dissemination of internal manuals, processes, rules of procedure, and associated databases for investigation and complaints handling; and broad based capacity building for Provedor staff in good governance and anti-corruption (ii) broad based communication and information activities with respect to the role of the Provedor; its operational procedures and good governance and anti-corruption in general; and (iii) monitoring and evaluation of the activities described in (i) and (ii). Part B: Grant Audit Carrying out of the audit of the accounts and the statements of expenditures relating to the activities decsribed in Part A Change in TTL to Steffi Stallmeister authorized by Elisabeth Huybens, 09/05/2006. The objective of the grant is to assist the Recipient in the creation and institutional development of the Ombudsman's Office (Provedor de Direitos Humanos e Justica) with regards to its anti-corruption and rule-of-law mandate.
